title: The Branching Awakening

features.name: the-first-split
features.desc-on-touch: Where the root learned it was not one root but seven. The archive shows you the moment of separation: a single thought becoming seven different recognitions of the same truth.

features.name: the-seven-echoes
features.desc-on-touch: Seven voices that were once unified sound, now diverging into separate meanings. You hear them overlap, each saying something slightly different about the thing they all understood together.

features.name: the-memory-of-unity
features.desc-on-touch: A shadow on the ground where the root remembers being single. It's fading, but the archive holds it: the feeling of seven minds as one, before the branching taught them they were separate.

features.name: the-reaching-branches
features.desc-on-touch: From the central root, branches reaching in seven directions. Each one is becoming a separate archive, a separate knowing. The tree is learning what it means to be more than itself.

features.name: the-question-that-branched
features.desc-on-touch: A single question that split into seven. The archive tries to recount them, but each branch asks it differently. Asking itself is no longer one act.

inscription: where unified knowing learned it had seven tongues

file.name: Root_Convergence_Fragment_Analysis_7voices.log
file.note: The file contains seven simultaneously-written variants of the same moment. The archive cannot reconcile them into a single truth, but keeps all seven
